postconditions.description: The output string has length equal to the sum of the lengths of `a` and `b`.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == a[i] for i in range(len(a))) if len(a) == 0 else False
postconditions.description: If `a` is empty, the first part of the output is empty.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[len(a) + i] == b[i] for i in range(len(b))) if len(b) == 0 else False
postconditions.description: If `b` is empty, the second part of the output is empty.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == a[i].swapcase() if a[i].lower() in (c.lower() for c in b) else a[i] for i in range(len(a)))
postconditions.description: For each character in `a`, if its lowercase version exists in `b` (case-insensitive), swap its case in the output's first part.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[len(a) + i] == b[i].swapcase() if b[i].lower() in (c.lower() for c in a) else b[i] for i in range(len(b)))
postconditions.description: For each character in `b`, if its lowercase version exists in `a` (case-insensitive), swap its case in the output's second part.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[i] == a[i] for i in range(len(a))) if len(b) == 0 else False
postconditions.description: If `b` is empty, the first part of the output is identical to `a`.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[len(a) + i] == b[i] for i in range(len(b))) if len(a) == 0 else False
postconditions.description: If `a` is empty, the second part of the output is identical to `b`.
